drivingQuestion: Does the halakha follow R' Shimon on relatives testifying about the new moon?
outcomeNote: Rav's silence is explained away; Shmuel's chain independently rules like R' Shimon

segments.he: אָמַר לוֹ: וְהָא זִמְנִין סַגִּיאִין אֲמַרִית קַמֵּיהּ דְּרַב הִלְכְתָא כְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן וְלָא אֲמַר לִי וְלָא מִידֵּי! אֲמַר לֵיהּ: הֵיכִי תָּנֵית? אֲמַר לֵיהּ: אִפְּכָא. אֲמַר לֵיהּ: מִשּׁוּם הָכִי לָא אֲמַר לָךְ וְלָא מִידֵּי. אָמַר טָבִי בְּרֵיהּ דְּמָרִי טָבִי אָמַר מָר עוּקְבָא אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: הִלְכְתָא כְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן.
segments.en: Rav Ḥanan bar Rava «said to him: But many times I said before Rav» that «the halakha is in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabbi Shimon» on this matter, «and never did he say anything to me» to indicate that he disagreed. Rav Huna «said to him: How did you teach» the mishna? Rav Ḥanan bar Rava «said to him:» With «the opposite» attributions, that is say, the position that is attributed in the mishna to Rabbi Yosei, I would teach in the name of Rabbi Shimon. Rav Huna «said to him: Due to that» reason, «he never said anything to you,» for according to your version you ruled correctly. «Tavi, son of Mari Tavi, said» that «Mar Ukva said» that «Shmuel said: The halakha is in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabbi Shimon.»
